name: Pupellyverbos Port
summary: A crate of Pupellyverbos Port went overboard near the Hinterlands during a storm. Whiskey Slim in Booty Bay needs the bottles back before the captain discovers they are missing.

sections.title: Lost at Sea
sections.body: Off the Overlook Cliffs, a storm struck Whiskey Slim's ship. The captain had taken the crate of Pupellyverbos Port from a privateer bound for Stormwind, and Whiskey Slim broke into it for courage as the waves rose. A great wave swept the bottles overboard. Now the grog lies scattered along the shore, and Slim fears the captain's anger.

faq.answer: Pupellyverbos Port is the captain's grog, a crate his crew commandeered from a privateer bound for Stormwind.

faq.q: How did the bottles get lost?
faq.answer: A storm near the Overlook Cliffs sent a great wave over the ship and swept the bottles into the sea.

faq.q: Who is looking for the port?
faq.answer: Whiskey Slim in Booty Bay wants the lost bottles returned before the captain learns they are missing.

faq.q: Where did the crate come from?
faq.answer: The captain's crew commandeered the crate from a privateer traveling toward Stormwind.
